items.quote: this day have they offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before the LORD
items.claim: Burnt and sin offerings were made before the LORD on this day

items.quote: if I had eaten the sin offering to day, should it have been accepted in the sight of the LORD?
items.claim: Eating the sin offering in a state of affliction would not be acceptable to the LORD
items.place: in the sight of the LORD

items.quote: And when Moses heard that, he was content
items.claim: Moses was satisfied with Aaron's explanation
